verdict.rationale: Vanta publishes a live llms.txt (confirmed via direct probe returning HTTP 200) plus per-page .md docs endpoints, explicitly framed as the 'Vanta Developer Hub' for agentic use, and also ships agentskills.io-spec skill files and an MCP docs server for AI coding tools to consume its documentation directly. This directly matches the story of pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no independent/third-party confirmation that external agents successfully consume these docs in practice.
